component.name: ILOverlayFeedRequest
component.script: sub answer() if m.top.control <> "run" then return request = m.top.request if request.kind = "plan" then return m.top.result = { sessionId: request.sessionId, revision: request.revision, status: 200, body: formatJson({ continueUrl: "https://ads.example/cart", qrImageUrl: request.url + "/qr/" + request.variantId + ".png" }) } end sub
